headline: New Classroom Observation Policy, facilities use at new South Kingstown High School and Curtis Corner Athletic Complex, and removal of two policies.
summary: The agenda includes a proposed Classroom Observation Policy and use of the new high school and Curtis Corner Athletic Complex. Two Access to Excellence policies are recommended for removal from the policy book.
items: Discussion and action on the new proposed Classroom Observation Policy
Discussion and action on Use of Facilities #9205, including use of the soon-to-be-completed new South Kingstown High School and Curtis Corner Athletic Complex
Discussion and action on Middle School Access to Excellence #8335 and Access to Excellence Chemical Health Policy #8330, with a recommendation to remove them from the policy book
Upcoming policies, meetings, and tasks (no action will be taken)
location: Administration Building Conference Room, 307 Curtis Corner Rd, Wakefield, Rhode Island
